/ First Class /
<Product Designer />
AI Builder Workshop
1.subtitle: From Figma Design System to Strapi Database, complete your Side Project in 2 days

instructorBio.name: Harry Chuang
instructorBio.title: 18+ Years of UI/UX Design & Front-end Development
experience: Former designer at TutorMing & Shopmatic; Design Consultant for KKDay's first App
Built a shared Storybook component library for Shopmatic's Singapore × India cross-border team
teaching: AAPD Online Course Instructor | Design Tokens & Design System
Corporate Trainer for QNAP, UXY, IxDA Workshops
Featured Writer at Codrops | AI × Design System Development
instructorBio.codropsArticleText: Read Codrops Article: AI × Design System × Product Development

highlights: Use AI Builder to create web products

valueProposition.title: From Figma Design System to Strapi Database, complete your Side Project in 2 days

usp.title: Start from Design System, Build Design Tokens
usp.description: Learn how to convert Figma Variables into CSS Design Tokens, build a complete design system architecture, and seamlessly bridge design and development.

usp.title: Integrate Frontend & Backend Development
usp.description: Not just static websites - I'll teach you to build databases with Strapi (Headless CMS) and deploy with Netlify.

usp.title: AI-Powered (AI Builder)
usp.description: Use Cursor + AI Agent throughout the course. You handle the logic, AI writes the code.

usp.title: Architecture-First AI Builder
usp.description: With Design Tokens, component-based architecture, and clear data structures, AI develops within defined guidelines. Your project stays maintainable and scalable.

syllabus.title: Design System & Component Digitization (The Foundation)

sessions.title: [Opening] Product Designers in the AI Era
sessions.description: Understand why designers should learn development. Master the core of AI Builder: using logic to direct AI to write good code, and get familiar with Cursor.

sessions.title: [Specification] Design Tokens Conversion Practice
sessions.description: Sync Figma variables with code. Learn to convert design specs into AI-readable Design Tokens, building the visual foundation of your project.

sessions.title: [Component] Storybook Component Library Development
sessions.description: Direct AI to quickly build a UI component library. From base components to Storybook docs, create your own reusable digital design assets.

sessions.title: [Advanced] Figma MCP Integration
sessions.description: Set up Figma MCP to let Cursor directly connect to your design file. AI no longer guesses from screenshots—it can precisely read component structures, spacing, and color variables, dramatically improving development accuracy.

syllabus.outcome: A Storybook component library that perfectly matches your design system.

syllabus.title: Inject Soul & Product Launch (The Soul & MVP)

sessions.title: [Assembly] Product Interface & Local Data Testing
sessions.description: Assemble components into a complete product page. Practice testing the UI with mock data and learn basic version control with Git.

sessions.title: [Brain] Strapi CMS Setup & AI Modeling
sessions.description: Quickly set up a backend management system. Understand data structures, learn how AI can help you build a database, and turn static content into dynamic management.

sessions.title: [Integration] Injecting Soul from Static to Dynamic
sessions.description: Bridge the data gap between frontend and backend. Implement interactive features like "Like" buttons to make your site more than just a static page.

sessions.title: [Deployment] GitHub × Netlify Launch Ceremony
sessions.description: Push your code to GitHub and connect your repository to Netlify with one click. Once set up, every Push will auto-deploy, allowing anyone in the world to access your product via a dedicated URL.

sessions.title: [Presentation] Demo Day & Graduation
sessions.description: Showcase your results. Demo the live product you built, complete with a backend, and graduate.

syllabus.outcome: A live, database-backed, accessible personal MVP product.

mentorship.title: Exclusive Post-Course Support
mentorship.description: Learning shouldn't stop when the class ends. I'll set up a dedicated Discord community and host biweekly online Office Hours (30-60 mins) for four weeks after the workshop. I'll personally help you overcome technical hurdles and ensure your Side Project's core features are successfully launched.

pricing.schedule:
【Session 1】1/24(Sat) - 1/25(Sun)
【Session 2】1/31(Sat) - 2/1(Sun)
10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, 10 hours total over 2 days
pricing.location: Near Taipei Main Station (Detailed location TBA)

1.slidesEmbed: <iframe src="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/e/2PACX-1vQshRWYI-mc5Jq-L6L2kvMWYXMqhwtFTnHkHRVhrPmG-5d4itIQIQZE_LfSirMBsVvljCxmrzQOLbuX/pubembed?start=false&loop=false&delayms=3000" frameborder="0" width="1280" height="749" allowfullscreen="true" mozallowfullscreen="true" webkitallowfullscreen="true"></iframe>

faq.question: Can I join if I have no coding experience?
faq.answer: Absolutely! The core of this course is teaching you to use AI (Cursor) to write code. You only need to understand design logic.

faq.question: What should I prepare?
faq.answer: A laptop, a paid Figma account (for Variables and Dev Mode features), SourceTree installed, and pre-registered accounts for GitHub, Netlify, and Cursor (we'll provide a setup guide).

faq.question: Who is this course for? What prerequisites are required?
faq.answer: This is an intermediate to advanced course designed for product designers who want to expand into development. Before registering, you should have: (1) Figma proficiency: Familiar with core features like Components and Variables (2) Product design experience: A basic understanding of the product development process from ideation to delivery. If you're a UI/UX designer who wants to bring your designs to life, this course is perfect for you!
